eras.label: 1940s
eras.name: Central Utah Vocational School
eras.text: UVU began in 1941 as a vocational school training workers for the war effort, then became Utah Trade Technical Institute in 1945.

eras.label: 1960s
eras.name: Utah Technical College at Provo
eras.text: As Utah Technical College, the school grew its technical and trade programs for a growing Utah County.

eras.label: 1980s
eras.name: Utah Valley Community College
eras.text: Becoming a community college opened general education and transfer programs to many more students.

eras.label: 1990s
eras.name: Utah Valley State College
eras.text: UVSC added its first four-year bachelor's degrees and grew into one of the largest colleges in the state.

eras.name: Utah Valley University
eras.text: UVU became a university in 2008 and is now the largest university in Utah.
